segments.name: Target
segments.description: Operates stores and digital channels offering fashionable, differentiated merchandise and everyday essentials at discounted prices to guests.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single segment designed to enable guests to purchase products seamlessly in stores or through our digital channels.

revenueModel.text: Guests purchase merchandise through stores and digital channels; the company also generates revenue from advertising, credit card profit-sharing, marketplace fees, and in-store amenities.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to Merchandise Sales, we generate revenue from other sources, most notably advertising revenue and credit card profit-sharing income.
